summary: Dedicated IT Manager well‑versed in analyzing and mitigating risk and finding cost‑effective solutions. Excels at boosting performance and productivity by establishing realistic goals and enforcing deadlines.

Drove business KPIs through rapid iteration of customer‑facing product features.
Identified customer pain points and latent needs through end‑to‑end experience analysis.
Collaborated with global teams to resolve IT support cases.
Built and maintained a staff of five, terminating one employee for cause.
Created and audited inter‑team processes, adjusting as required.
Managed travel and budget for staff on‑site visits.
Owned SaaS customers in North America, Canada and Australia.
Defined project deliverables and monitored task status.
Executed proof‑of‑concept implementations to validate product feasibility.

SQL administration and NEC PBX deployment.
